# Warm Outreach Pipeline

Research your warmest contacts and draft personal DMs.

Use for an outreach plan with DMs for several warm contacts. Not for one DM to a named person (write it directly).

**The user might say:** "Build a warm outreach plan from my warmest contacts: research each one and draft a personal DM. Do not send anything."

## Steps

1. Their warmest contacts.
   ```sh
   xholic contacts list --intent HOT --limit 10
   ```
2. Research each.
   ```sh
   xholic people get --username <handle>
   ```
3. Write a personal DM for each yourself. Send nothing; offer the reply-to-dm-campaign steps if they want Xholic to send.
